ev.q: 26 countries offered PCV7 to all children as part of national immunization programs or had PCV7 in widespread use
59 (82%) have a mortality rate of >50 per 1,000 live births among children aged <5 years
Twenty-four of the 26 countries (92%) are high-income countries characterized by low childhood mortality
only 26 of 193 (14%) WHO member states have introduced PCV7
these countries are primarily high-income countries with relatively few childhood deaths
Of the 72 countries that are eligible for funding from the GAVI Alliance
a database maintained by WHO was used to identify all countries that had introduced PCV7 by August 2008

methods_quotes.q: Countries were characterized by their economic status using World Bank income classifications based on gross national income per capita
Mortality data were obtained from the most recent statistics (from 2006) reported to the WHO Statistical Information System.
